notes: «وبهذا الإسناد» takes over the prefix of prev2 (prev1 writes no chain): «أبي» and «سعد بن عبد الله». The text then continues «عن أحمد بن أبي عبد الله» itself, so that name is the reader's own link.
The back reference is not written separately; prev2's «رفعه» and the chain after Ahmad are not taken over.
The Imam is «أبا عبد الله», written as in the text and not identified (rule 3); the «ع» blessing is excluded.
